result.description: Cloud phone system / call center platform for sales and support teams, with calls, SMS, contacts, users, numbers and AI features.
result.auth_detail: Basic Auth with API ID + API key generated in the Aircall Dashboard (private apps, single account). OAuth 2.0 auth-code flow (scope public_api) for public multi-customer apps; client credentials only via Tech Partner program.
result.access_detail: Basic Auth keys are self-serve but require an existing paid Aircall account (no free developer sandbox for private apps). OAuth for multi-customer apps requires joining the Aircall Technology Partner Program and an app review. Plan tier for API access is not clearly stated publicly (Send Message API needs Professional).
result.api_notes: REST Public API covering calls, contacts, users, teams, numbers, tags, messages/SMS, webhooks, companies, insight cards, and more. Reference at developer.aircall.io/api-references.
result.blocker: Multi-customer OAuth requires Aircall Tech Partner approval; otherwise users must supply their own API ID/key (Basic Auth) from a paid Aircall account. No vendor-official MCP server (Aircall only documents registering third-party MCPs into its AI).

evidence.quote: Aircall supports two ways to authenticate with the REST API: Basic Authentication and OAuth.
A Public App is built to be distributed to multiple Aircall customers. To build one, you must first join the Aircall Technology Partner Program
A Private App is built for a single Aircall account.
To access the API securely, Aircall uses API Keys for authentication.
Registering an MCP with Aircall makes your tools and resources available to every Aircall AI customer, so it can call them directly instead of relying on a custom, hardcoded integration.
